label: I need a door hung or repaired
reason: Cooke is listed for carpentry and home repairs. Describe the door, frame and hardware to discuss the right scope.
prepare: Interior or exterior, and how many doors?
New installation, replacement or repair?
Any frame, hardware or trim work needed?

label: I want to replace or repair windows
reason: Start by discussing the window scope with Cooke. Confirm installation services, products and coverage directly.
prepare: How many windows and what type?
Repair, replacement or surrounding trim work?
Any product selection or photos to share directly?

label: I’m thinking about a deck or porch
reason: Discuss your deck or porch project with Cooke. Confirm the scope, design and permit responsibilities before arranging work.
prepare: New construction or an existing deck repair?
Approximate size, height and materials?
Any plans, stairs or railings to consider?

label: I want to remodel or build an addition
reason: Discuss whether the project is a fit with Cooke. Confirm scope, design, engineering, permits and scheduling directly.
prepare: Which space and what would you like to change?
Approximate size and intended use?
Do you have drawings or a proposed timeline?

label: A room needs painting or drywall work
reason: Painting and drywall services are not confirmed in this directory. Ask Cooke whether the project is a fit before arranging work.
prepare: Interior or exterior, and which surfaces?
Any patching, drywall repair or preparation?
Approximate size and your preferred timing?

label: The heat or AC stopped working
reason: Heating and cooling equipment belongs with an HVAC technician.
prepare: What stopped working, and when?
Equipment type: Furnace, Heat Pump or ductless?
Any message on the thermostat or equipment?

label: One room is never comfortable
reason: Start with an HVAC assessment of the room and existing system before assuming you need new equipment.
prepare: Which room, and which season is worse?
Does the rest of the home feel comfortable?
Has this always happened, or is it new?

label: There’s no hot water
reason: Middletown HVAC handles tank and tankless Water Heaters. Choose Water Heater service rather than a general drain request.
prepare: Tank or tankless, if you know?
Gas, electric or another fuel?
Any visible leak or displayed error?

label: The radiators or baseboards aren’t heating
reason: A Boiler specialist is the appropriate starting point for hot-water heating systems.
prepare: Gas or oil, if you know?
All rooms affected, or only some?
Any visible leak, noise or error message?

label: I got an expensive replacement recommendation
reason: A second opinion gives you another assessment before deciding on a major repair or replacement.
prepare: The written recommendation and quoted scope.
Equipment make, model and age, if available.
What symptoms led to the first visit?

label: I’m planning a new system or ductless
reason: An HVAC installation estimate should address the home, existing equipment and the comfort you want to improve.
prepare: Your current system and fuel.
Rooms or floors you want to improve.
Your preferred timing and any existing proposal.

label: I want seasonal care for my equipment
reason: Ask about a maintenance visit and Get Comfortable Plans with Middletown HVAC.
prepare: Equipment type and number of systems.
When was the last maintenance visit?
Any current issue that needs a diagnostic visit?

label: An outlet, light or electrical circuit needs attention
reason: An electrician handles household electrical repairs and installation inquiries.
prepare: What is affected, and where?
Is this a repair or a planned improvement?
Any earlier electrician’s findings?

label: A drain, pipe or fixture needs attention
reason: General plumbing, drain and fixture inquiries belong with the plumbing listing.
prepare: Which fixture or area is affected?
A leak, blockage or planned replacement?
How long has it been happening?

label: I need carpentry or help with a home repair
reason: Cooke Carpentry & Construction is listed for carpentry and handyman project inquiries.
prepare: What would you like repaired or built?
Approximate size and material, if known.
A couple of photos to share directly with the business.
